title: FREE REQUEST Looking for a writing buddy

posts.author: Mattaroni
posts.body:
I'm struggling to develop a coherent storyboard for my next game, which is a mild Dark Fantasy JRPG with a Revenge Story plotline.
I'm still relatively new to Game Development, but I have released a couple of jam projects, and this is my first time trying a bigger project, and I'm using RPG Maker MZ.
I'm writing a Reverse RPG sort of game. It takes place AFTER your typical generic JRPG story of "hero goes on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord & save the world".
You play as the son of the deceased Demon Lord as he wants to enact revenge against the heroes who killed his father.
You'll team up with other demons and monsters. Basically, it's a JRPG where you play as the villains.
So I'm looking for someone who's good at writing Dark Fantasy stories.
If you're interested, let me know. (^ . ^)v

posts.author: thecloakgirl
posts.body:
Hello! I love writing so I'd be happy to lend a hand!
A couple of things about me, though:
1. I won't be available to work on your project (or anyone else's) until after the new year. I have to finish up this year by finishing the edit of my novel as well as making an RPG Maker game for my husband's Christmas present haha
2. I don't write any swearing. It's a personal rule.
3. I don't write any intimate bedroom scenes. Kissing/cuddling/flirting/etc. is fine.
If these don't work for you that's understandable and I hope you're able to find someone to help bring your project to life. If they do work, then great! Let me know and we'll figure it out
I'm linking a
couple
short
stories
that I wrote to give you a feel for my writing style. (There's three stories linked there, one per word)
